title: Hajun script fnaf 2 reimagined you wont struggle
features:
1️⃣ Player Controls
	•	FullBright toggle:
Adjusts Lighting: Brightness, ClockTime, and Ambient.
	•	Camera FOV slider:
Adjustable FOV from 10 → 130.
	•	Auto Fix All Cameras toggle:
Automatically reactivates all cameras (1,2,3,4,7,10,12,13) every second while enabled.

⸻

2️⃣ Robot Notify System
	•	Robot Notify toggle:
Alerts when animatronics approach, based on distance to the player:
	•	ALERT_DISTANCE = 15 → proximity alert
	•	EXTREME_DISTANCE = 6 → very close alert
	•	Notifications include:
	•	Freddy → "Freddy is close — go find Freddy" or "⚠️ Freddy is RIGHT NEXT TO YOU"
	•	Foxy → "Foxy is close — go flash Foxy" or "⚠️ Foxy is RIGHT NEXT TO YOU"
	•	Other animatronics → "Robot nearby: Name" or "⚠️ Robot VERY CLOSE: Name"
	•	Cooldowns prevent spam:
	•	Normal alerts: 10 seconds
	•	Extreme alerts: 5 seconds

⸻

3️⃣ ESP System (Animatronics ESP)
	•	Automatically creates ESP for every animatronic in workspace.ActiveAnimatronics.
	•	Features per model:
	•	BillboardGui Text → shows name + distance in meters
	•	Highlight Outline → shows model edges
	•	Tracers → lines from screen center to animatronic
	•	ESP Toggles:
	•	Name ESP
	•	Outline ESP
	•	Tracers
	•	ESP Color Picker → lets you change text, outline, and tracer colors.
	•	Automatically adds ESP for newly spawned animatronics (ChildAdded listener).

⸻

4️⃣ Camera Controls
	•	Buttons for each camera (1,2,3,4,7,10,12,13) to reactivate them via server event.
	•	Works in conjunction with the Auto Fix All Cameras toggle.

⸻

5️⃣ Music Player
	•	Plays specific songs by asset ID: Midnights, Montegn Rando, Tomma, Kirk, Lost Cannon.
	•	Volume Slider (0–10)
	•	Stop Button
	•	Individual Play Buttons for each song.

⸻

6️⃣ Distance Tracking
	•	ESP shows distance in meters from your player to each animatronic.
	•	Notifications use distance calculations for alert triggers.
